purpose: Evidence for every part of the Pulse feature vector and scoring, not only the 29 explicit syscalls (syscall-arms). Each arm removes one part with everything else equal.
reference_arm: base29 = the full Pulse vector (249 columns x 4 windows) with the joint tree+support p-value

fitted_arms.drop_ratios: ratio of the 29 syscalls to all calls (29-57)
fitted_arms.drop_aggregates: log/ratio of other calls, log total, sensitive ratio, seccomp denials (58-62)
fitted_arms.drop_rolling: rolling-10 mean and std of the 29 syscalls (191-248)
fitted_arms.bins_only: keep only aggregates and both bin groups (no explicit syscall channel at all)
fitted_arms.history1: context of current + 1 previous window instead of 3
fitted_arms.history2: context of current + 2 previous windows instead of 3

evaluation_variants_without_refit.base29@tree: tree branch p-value only (no support branch)
evaluation_variants_without_refit.base29@support: support branch p-value only; the support branch sees only the current vector, so this is also 'no temporal history'

not_tested_and_reported_as_limits: window length 500 ms (needs a new capture)
rolling window length 10 and hash bin count 64 (hyperparameters, not groups)

data.fit: syscall-arms normal selection data, same train/calibration split, same capped sample indices, seeds 73021-73023, no attack data
data.normal_holdout: syscall-arms normal holdout span (24 h, never used for fitting); calibration on its first 20 %, burden on the rest
attacks: pulse-live-recalibrated main + follow-up campaigns with benign-launch controls (1238 paired trials)

decision_policy: k2of2 temporal confirmation (as policy-2of2-a10 run by Pulse), alpha scale matched per arm to the budget
statistics: paired, workload-clustered bootstrap (10000 resamples) of differences to base29; one-sided 95 % bounds
metrics: p95 of first positive window_end - kernel event

rules_per_component.needed: removing it lowers recall with the 95 % CI of the difference entirely below 0 on BOTH attack sets, OR lowers separation with the CI entirely below 0 on pulse-live-recalibrated, OR raises p95 delay by >= 0.2 s on both sets
rules_per_component.removable: recall non-inferior (one-sided 95 % lower bound > -3 points) on BOTH sets AND separation lower bound > -3 points AND p95 not worse by > 0.2 s on either set
rules_per_component.budget_fallback: rules are applied at the primary budget; if base29 has no matched scale there, at the secondary budget

consequence_for_pulse: The current feature set stays unless a component is 'removable'. A removable component is only a candidate for simplification: it needs a refit, freeze and live test before any change. No automatic promotion.
evidence_class: development; normal holdout unadjudicated; pulse-attack-dev scenarios were used while developing Pulse
